//: Every command in stage1 was run once, in this project, before being written here.
//verification: The one thing this repository cannot work out for you: what checks this project has, and where the change stops being under your control once it ships. artifact_kind: service | library | cli | chart | migration | model-boundary | plugin.

stage2: set -a; . ./gopnik.local.env; set +a; curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONWATCH_METRICS_TOKEN" "$LOOMWATCH_STAND_URL/metrics" | grep "^onwatch_build_info" | grep -qF "$(cat VERSION)"
v=$(cat VERSION); d=$(mktemp -d); helm pull oci://ghcr.io/concordloom/charts/loomwatch --version "$v" -d "$d" && helm template lw "$d/loomwatch-$v.tgz" > /dev/null && rm -rf "$d"
verification.notes: Stage 2 runs against the deployed instance. Its address and credentials are machine-local and live in gopnik.local.env, which .gitignore keeps out of commits; every stage2 command sources that file, so nothing about a particular deployment is written here. Delivery is post-release and manual: pushing a loom-v* tag publishes the image and the chart, and the deployment is moved to that version by hand afterwards, so a Stage 2 run gates the release rather than the merge, and it fails until the deployment has actually been moved to the revision under test. The first cell proves the deployed revision from the login page; the metrics cell proves it again from onwatch_build_info; scripts/check-deployed-ui.py carries its own negative case, a wrong password that must be refused, and it runs before the real login because five failures block the address. The last cell covers the chart surface by pulling the published artifact for this revision and rendering it. tests/js/dashboard-test.js is deliberately not in stage1 - nothing in the repository installs its npm dependencies, so it cannot run here.
